title: Mellony C NDE 4915
content: I had not long been given two cats. I am semi-handicapped and rely on help from others for daily tasks and assistance with mobility. This day I was clearing out a cat box, which contained ammonia, and I am careful to have my windows open when doing this. Unfortunately, as I was cleaning the box I fell from my wheelchair and landed near the box. I was unable to move away from the box and began to inhale the fumes. As I struggled to breathe, I knew I was in a dangerous situation as I began to feel very unwell. I quickly began to sense a tightness on my chest and began vomiting. Suddenly I felt my head feel full of pressure, which felt similar to wearing a tight hat. For some reason I began to feel at peace and knew I was safe but didn't know why. As the feeling increased, I was suddenly propelled out of my body and could see my body beneath me lying on the cork flooring beside the cat box. I began to feel a pulling sensation and knew I was travelling very quickly. During this time, I could hear music and bells ringing all around me. Suddenly it went black and I could see nothing but felt at ease. I wondered why I was in darkness and thought maybe I was trapped. Quickly a light appeared to my left and I felt attracted to it. My self felt like an energy full of power and love. I could hear the vibe and voices of other ladies and men who were passing over to be with the holy mother with sure love and warmth. I could hear a strange language spoken to me. It told me that my daughter who is mentally challenged would receive a great reward in the future and that I would find love for my very ill grandmother. I was told I had to go back. As soon as this was said, I was pulled away and entered my body through my head. My support worker had arrived and I was being given oxygen. When I was taken to hospital, I was told I was very lucky to have survived. Even more amazing my grandmother whom I had not spoken to for twenty years or more was in a ward very close to me. We ended up forgiving each other on my second day in hospital and have been so close ever since. Eleven years after this event happened to me my daughter received treatment, which has greatly improved her quality of life. I will always remember my experience and have no fear of death now.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Felt a pulling sensation and traveling very quickly; then it went black (darkness).
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Music and bells ringing all around.

arrival.other_being_detail: Heard “voices of other ladies and men who were passing over”.

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness/blackness, then a light appeared to the left; music and bells.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Pulled away and entered the body through the head.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell from wheelchair near a cat box containing ammonia; inhaled fumes and struggled to breathe.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard music/bells; darkness; heard voices of other people; “strange language” spoken.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with rapid pulling/travel, then darkness, then light appeared, communication, told to return, then re-entry through head.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Auditory phenomena (music and bells); “strange language” conveying future outcomes; re-entered body through head.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “propelled out of my body and could see my body beneath me”; “My self felt like an energy full of power and love.”; “I was told I had to go back.”; “have no fear of death now.”
